solution:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Collectible"** is spelled correctly.
 
• **Collectible** is an adjective meaning "worth collecting" or "suitable to be collected as a hobby or investment."
 
• All other options (2, 3, and 4) are incorrect as they contain spelling errors.

Correct usage: "The rare coin was considered a valuable collectible."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Incorrect options explained:**
 
 
• **Option 2 (Collecteble):** Incorrect due to the incorrect use of "e" instead of "i" before "ble."
 
• **Option 3 (Colletible):** Incorrect due to the omission of "c" after "o."
 
• **Option 4 (Collectibel):** Incorrect due to the incorrect placement of "e" and "i" before "ble."
 
 
 
• Words ending in "-ible" or "-able" are often tricky to spell, but **"Collectible"** is the standard form in English.
